text_block_list.text: Pant, pant... Phew...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Crazy trainer. She should learn when to
keep her mouth shut.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
(People have always been such a pain. I
can't stand any of them.)
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Your shoes? Oh yeah, I saw 'em! Up in that
tree!
text_block_list.name: Boy A

text_block_list.text:
But wait, you can't reach that high. Guess
you've just gotta jump!
text_block_list.name: Boy B

text_block_list.text:
Poor Taishin, stuck sitting all by herself.
Who wants to go try talking
to her?
text_block_list.name: Девочка А

text_block_list.text:
Ewww, not me! She's so weird! Let's
rock-paper-scissors for it.
text_block_list.name: Girl B

text_block_list.text: Making fun of me and bullying me for the dumbest reasons. Like I'd ever wanna be friends with them.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Every single day was such a pain in the ass.
But then... I found racing.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: It was the only good thing I had.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: Pant, pant...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: Aaaaagh!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: Whoa, awesome!
text_block_list.name: Classmate A

text_block_list.text:
Hey, isn't that... Нарита Таисин? That puny
loner can run?!
text_block_list.name: Classmate B

text_block_list.text:
So I lived to race. Because by winning, I
could leave all the idiots
choking in the
dust.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
If I could get away from them all, to the
other side of the finish line...
I knew I'd
finally be able to breathe easy.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
So I went full sprint ahead. I even
imagined going for the Twinkle
Series.
But...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: Pant, pant... Yes! I got first!
text_block_list.name: Умамусумэ А

text_block_list.text: Pant, gasp. Crap!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Hey, your name's Нарита Таисин, isn't it? I
heard you're going to
Tracen Academy in
the spring. That true?
text_block_list.name: Умамусумэ А

text_block_list.text: I don't see what it has to do with you.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: More like, what does it have to do with you? You know it's an elite school for runners with talent, right?
text_block_list.name: Умамусумэ А

text_block_list.text:
What would they want a little runt like you
for? You'll never get in!
text_block_list.name: Умамусумэ А

text_block_list.text:
I wanted to tell her to shut up, or that I'd
show her, or a million other
things that
came to mind.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
But even now, I can feel the words still
stuck in my throat.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: Pant, pant, gasp...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
(Damn... What the hell is going on? How
can they be this much
better?! There's not
an inch to squeeze through to the front!)
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: (Tracen Academy... is no joke!)
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: Gasp, gasp... Agh...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: (Can't breathe...)
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: (I can't... catch my breath...)
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: No.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: No... I'm not letting it end here!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Long after the lights are out for the night,
a small shadow crosses the
course. With a
gulp, I go to confirm my suspicions.

Sure enough, it's her again—Narita
Taishin— looking somewhat
distressed.
Pant... Pant...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
She's clearly on the verge of collapsing. So
without second thought, I
call out to her.
Huh? Who the heck are you?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин
choice_data_list: You're going to get yourself injured.

text_block_list.text: Get lost. Why would I listen to you?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Uuugh! I said, beat it! I'm sick of you
idiots!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
"Don't be reckless." "It's too dangerous."
Well? Go ahead! I know
you're just itching
to say it! "Racing isn't for you," right?!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
"You're too short!" "You're too frail!"
"You're not cut out to be a
racer!"
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
All that junk—I'm sick and tired of hearing
it!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Seeing her intensity, I freeze, unsure how
to respond. Bitterly, she
continues.

Okay?! I don't care what people say! I'm
gonna stay right on the turf!
I'll show all
you whiny morons!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
I'll show you exactly where I should be!
And I'll be laughing when I
tell you to
shove it from the winner's circle!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: The look in her eyes is unmistakable.

It's the unquenchable thirst for victory—a
terrible and unshakable
drive.
Ah haaaaah! Found youuu, Taishiiiiin!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
What are you thinking, staying out this
late?! All the lights are off! It's
dangerous!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: Ugh... What the heck are you doing here?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
What else! I'm here to come get you! I was
sooo worried waiting in the
dorm for you,
Taishin!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: I don't need you to worry about me.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: Huh?! H-hey, wait up, Taishiiin!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
The course goes quiet, leaving me alone
with my thoughts.

The fire in her soul ignites something in
me, and my pulse refuses to
slow down.
